replies.content: It seems like the model might not have downloaded successfully. During the first run, it downloaded some data, executed very quickly, and successfully utilized the GPU. On the second run, there was no indication that any data was being downloaded; while the code executed, it didn't appear to be using the GPU—it likely defaulted to the CPU. I’m wondering if, on subsequent runs, the notebook waits for a data download to complete before it actually engages the GPU.
